correctness.rationale: Exact seven-equation equilibrium elimination proves complete neutral segment at ψ=0 and unique positive two-strain equilibrium at ψ>0. The swapped-strain symmetry isolates the 3×3 retarded linear block. Modulus inequalities rigorously bound all complex characteristic roots, and real strict monotonicity plus the implicit-function theorem gives the unique simple dominant root and its sharp coefficient for arbitrary finite delays. Attached checker tests representative residuals but is not substituted for proof.

source_inspections.title: Theoretical conditions for the coexistence of viral strains with differences in phenotypic traits: a bifurcation analysis

value.rationale: The parent paper explicitly centers its biological interpretation on saturation enabling coexistence. The exact exceptional neutral segment at the bilinear boundary and the first-order, delay-dependent vanishing exchange spectral gap quantify nonuniform stability and exceptionally slow strain mixing. This is a mathematically motivated limit/structural boundary question; the result is neither a raw substitution nor a duplicate of the already-known generic neutral-line phenomenon.
